title: Great deal
text: I used a special price during Prime Days and got the subscription cheaper, which helped seal the deal. Since I obviously didn't know what to expect, I probably wouldn't have paid full price to begin with. However, I feel this subscription box is really worth it. I signed up for the 40 DVDs for $39.99 monthly. It took about three weeks to receive the first box, but I was so excited when it finally got here. I received a total of 43 DVD's. Several of the movies were bonus packs or had 2 or three discs with it. One thing I don't like is that you have to request a minimum of 4 genres for them to fill. I requested horror, mystery/drama, war, and science fiction. I was disappointed that maybe 2 were horror, (if Resident Evil is horror) which was my first choice of genres. There were a lot of fantasy and superhero movies included. I'm going to stay with it for a few more months. I think its a really great idea!
label: positive
